articles.summary: JUPITER, Fla., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Ligand Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (Nasdaq: LGND) today announced that it will report second quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 6, 2026. The company will hold a conference call beginning at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time to discuss the results and provide a general business update. Conference Call and Webcast Information Date: Thursday, August 6, 2026 Time: 8:30 a.m. Eastern time Conference Call: United States (Local): +1 (585) 542-9983 United States (Toll-Free): +1 (833) 461-5787 International: Global Dial-in Numbers Meeting ID: 780702347 Webcast: Live and replay webcasts of the call are available here . About Ligand Ligand is a leading royalty aggregator, partnering with biopharmaceutical companies to finance and advance late-stage clinical development programs.
